The intervening narrow corridor and southwest corner beside Kingsley Lake have no exact named-water partition established. The coarse ring crosses mapped land and omits substantial northern, western and eastern detailed continuations. Entire detailed named-lake extents remain unverified. Exact extent and product-name application are not approved.
